in_marathi.name: Shubhankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Good Luck
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shubhankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shubhankar is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shubh’ which means ‘auspicious’ or ‘good fortune’ and ‘ankar’ which means ‘to bring’ or ‘to carry’. This name is therefore a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy, as it suggests that he will be a bringer of good luck and prosperity in the lives of those around him.
